definitions.gloss: insurance money; insurance payout; insurance benefit
definitions.explanation: The money paid out by an insurance company when a claim is made, such as after an accident, illness, or death.

examples.japanese: {保険金|ほけんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}した→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保険金|ほけんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく⟦{支払|しはら}われた→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: The insurance money for the accident was finally paid out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保険金|ほけんきん}{受取人|うけとりにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I completed the procedure to change the beneficiary of the life insurance policy.

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguish from ⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧ (insurance premium), which is the amount paid by the policyholder. {保険金|ほけんきん} is the payout received from the insurance company.
